root_idea.summary: The root centers on elevation in a constructed or supported thing, with extensions to roofs, trellises, seats, authority, and other elevated or supporting structures.
root_idea.development: From building and securing a raised structure, the root develops into terms for roofed shelters, vine trellises, royal or divine authority, structural support, and several figurative or anatomical applications.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Core Quran-attested nominal with roof, royal-seat, and divine usages.
Quran-attested passive participle, normalized to its singular citation form.

senses.definition: To build, construct, or erect a structure.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic occurrences, the verb describes people constructing or erecting what they build; the lexical usage is associated with raised or roof-like construction, including supporting structures.

senses.definition: A roof or roofed covering of a structure.
senses.usage_conditions: The plural عُرُوش occurs in the Quranic description of ruined buildings; the expression may describe roofs that have collapsed, with the walls subsequently falling upon them.

senses.definition: A corner, angle, or strong supporting side of a structure.
senses.usage_conditions: This is an alternative lexical interpretation of the Quranic expression خَاوِيَةٌ عَلَىٰ عُرُوشِهَا, distinct from the interpretation referring to roofs.

senses.definition: A throne or elevated seat of a king or ruler.
senses.usage_conditions: Used in Quranic accounts of royal authority, including the throne of Joseph's parents and the throne of the Queen of Sheba; it may metonymically evoke a ruler's elevated status.

senses.definition: The transcendent divine ʿArsh, a reality associated with God that is not definable in human physical terms.
senses.usage_conditions: Used in Quranic expressions concerning God's ʿArsh, including descriptions of its relation to the waters and divine epithets such as ذو العرش. The lexical discussion explicitly distinguishes this usage from a material support for God.

senses.definition: Trellised; furnished with or trained upon a raised support.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic form is a feminine plural passive participle describing cultivated plants, contrasting with plants that are not trellised; the support is understood as a structure such as a vine trellis.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A booth, shed, or roofed structure made for shade, commonly of canes, reeds, or palm sticks.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes temporary or simple structures used as shelters; the plural forms include عُرُوش and related plural patterns.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A house, dwelling, or building, including a building of palace-like form.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A broader application of the term to a place of abode or constructed building.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To case or line a well with wood, especially after securing its lower part with stones.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Describes the construction of a wooden casing in the upper or remaining part of a well.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To strike someone at the base of the neck.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized verbal construction with the person as object and the neck base as the place struck.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To roof or raise a building, or to make a trellis and train a vine's shoots upon it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The derived verb may describe roofing a house, constructing an ʿarsh or ʿarīsh, raising vine shoots onto supports, or bending the supports over which they are trained.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a bird, to rise and shade what is beneath it with its wings.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A derived, figurative or specialized use applied to a bird's wing-spreading posture.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To pitch a tent or tents.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form V intransitive construction referring to establishing a tented shelter.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become fixed, settled, or established in a country or town.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional extension from taking up a settled shelter or position.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make or take an ʿarīsh for oneself.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The Form VIII construction indicates acquiring or providing oneself with a shelter or trellis-like structure.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For grapes or shoots, to mount or spread upon a trellis.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in an intransitive construction with grapes or branches rising onto the supporting structure.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A wooden structure at a well, including the platform, shade, or casing used at its mouth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term may refer to the wood on which the water-drawer stands, a structure forming shade at the wellhead, or wooden casing above a stone-lined lower section.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A trellis or elevated wooden structure on which a grapevine spreads.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Typically made of sticks or pieces of wood shaped like a roof; عَرِيشٌ is the more common designation, while عَرْشٌ is also attested.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A named group or seat of stars in traditional Arab astronomy.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Includes the stellar group called the seat of al-Simāk and the group called the seat of al-Jawzāʾ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A bier for carrying a corpse.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Attested in the expression concerning the bier associated with the death of Saʿd ibn Muʿādh.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A bird's nest built in a tree.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative or assumed figurative application, apparently based on resemblance to a booth or shelter.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The head or chief who manages and regulates the affairs of a people or group.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative use likening the manager of affairs to the supporting or governing structure of a house.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A supporting basis, power, authority, or sovereignty.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In expressions such as ثُلَّ عَرْشُهُ, the loss or collapse of one's ʿarsh signifies loss of support, strength, power, or standing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The prominent upper part of the foot between the prominent ankle bone and the toes.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The lower surface of the foot is distinguished by another term; attested plurals include أَعْرَاش and عِرَشَة.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The base or lateral muscles, tissues, or structures of the neck.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The dual عُرْشَانِ is variously applied to the two elongated portions at the sides or base of the neck, associated with the vertebrae or nearby vessels.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The ear, or the two ears.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative use explained by proximity to the neck structures called the ʿurshān.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The extremity of the hair of a horse's mane.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized zoological use of the singular form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A bulky she-camel with a large chest or sides.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The form is explained by comparison with a chest or body enclosed like a well.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A structure resembling a woman's howdah, in which she sits on a camel.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Distinguished from a true howdah in some descriptions but similar in form; the name is explained by resemblance to a vine trellis.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An enclosure for livestock made to protect them from cold.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized shelter or pen of the type called حَظِيرَة.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Grapevines.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A lexicalized plural designation for vines associated with trellises.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A well cased with a wooden ʿarsh.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive participial description of a well whose upper or relevant section has been secured with the specified wooden structure.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A camel large in the sides.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized descriptive use of the passive participial form.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Building a house is covered by the general construction sense.

Booth or shed used for shade.
A palace-like building is covered by the building or dwelling meaning.

cautions: The divine ʿArsh is described in the supplied lexical evidence as a transcendent reality not physically definable by human conceptions; the English gloss “throne” should not be taken to imply a material support.
The supplied Lane text records عَمْشُ الثريا in one astronomical subunit, rather than the expected عرشُ الثريا; that stellar attribution is therefore left unresolved.
